第一卷 第23章 秦牧入天牢（第1页）
秦牧入天牢（秦牧入天牢（第22页）没毒。寻常的牢饭。秦牧端起来，几口扒完。腹中的饥饿感消退了几分，他抹了把嘴，重新闭上眼。破妄神瞳继续运转。他要在最短的时间内，找到逃出去的路。……天牢之外。消息如同长了翅膀，一夜之间传遍了整个天阙城。青楼本就是消息最灵通的地方，醉月楼出了人命，还是镇南侯世子，这等大事就算想瞒也瞒不住。街头的茶馆里，说书先生已经绘声绘色地讲了起来：“话说那秦家庶子，一巴掌拍碎窗棂，一脚将赵世子踹下二楼……”“那赵世子从半空跌落，‘砰’的一声，当场殒命！”“鲜血流了一地……”听客们听得入神，不时发出几声惊叹。有人低声议论：“那秦牧不是秦家庶子吗？怎么敢杀镇南侯世子？”“谁知道呢，据说是争风吃醋，为了个粉头。”“啧啧，一个庶子杀了侯府世子，这是要掉脑袋的。”“掉脑袋？怕是整个秦家都要跟着遭殃！”……镇南侯府。灵堂已经搭了起来。白幡在夜风中猎猎作响，纸钱的灰烬飘得满院都是。赵鸿的尸身停在堂中，脸上盖着白布，露在外面的手背青紫，指节僵硬。几个丫鬟跪在一旁，低声啜泣。赵天南站在灵前，面色铁青，指节捏得咔咔作响。他身后站着几个心腹幕僚，一个个噤若寒蝉，连大气都不敢喘。“查清楚了？”赵天南的声音十分平静，但其中的怒意已经压抑到了极点。“回侯爷。”一个黑衣人跪在地上，额头触地，“仵作验了三次，世子身上只有一处外伤，后脑撞击所致，体内无毒、无内伤，确系坠楼而亡。”“坠楼而亡？”赵天南冷笑一声，“我儿先天境七重修为，从二楼摔下去就死了？”黑衣人浑身一颤，不敢接话。“秦家那个畜生呢？”“已被锦衣卫押入天牢，等待刑部审理。”“审理？”赵天南转过身来，眼中满是血丝，“还要审理什么？杀人偿命，天经地义！让刑部的人把那畜生判了，本侯要看着他被砍头！”“侯爷息怒。”一个幕僚上前一步，压低声音，“此事恐怕没那么简单。那秦牧不过是个不受待见的庶子，与世子无冤无仇，怎会突然下此毒手？属下怀疑，背后另有隐情。”“隐情？”赵天南猛地转头，盯着那个幕僚，“你是说，有人指使他？”幕僚点了点头：“秦牧虽然不受宠，到底是秦家的人。他杀了世子，秦家脱不了干系。鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利。有人想看着侯爷与秦家斗起来，好坐收渔利。”赵天南沉默片刻，眼中的怒火渐渐被冷静取代。“你说的，不无道理。”他负手踱了两步，忽然停住，冷冷道：“但不管是谁指使，人是他杀的。秦家若不给本侯一个交代，本侯就去找雍王，让雍王来评这个理！”幕僚们对视一眼，都不敢再劝。赵天南是雍王的人，满朝皆知。而秦家，是燕王的人。两大藩王在朝中的势力，本就明争暗斗多年。如今再添上这条人命，怕是要彻底撕破脸了。“去，给雍王传信。”赵天南负手站在灵前，看着儿子青紫的脸，“告诉他，赵家需要他做主。”“是。”黑衣人领命而去。……

Volume 1 Chapter 23 Qin Mu enters the prison (page 1)
Qin Mu Enters the Heavenly Prison (Qin Mu Enters the Heavenly Prison (Page 22) It is not poisonous. It is an ordinary prison meal. Qin Mu picked it up and finished it in a few bites. The hunger in his belly subsided a little, he wiped his mouth and closed his eyes again. The Delusion Eyes continued to operate. He had to find a way out in the shortest possible time... Outside the Heavenly Prison. The news seemed to have grown wings and spread throughout the entire Tianque City overnight. The brothel is the place with the best information, Zuiyue The person who died in the building was still the prince of Zhennan. Even if he wanted to, he couldn't hide such a big thing. In the teahouse on the street, the storyteller had already started telling the story vividly: "Speaking of which, the bastard of the Qin family smashed the window lattice with his palm. Kicked Prince Zhao down to the second floor..." "The Prince Zhao fell from the air, and died on the spot with a 'bang'!" "Blood flowed all over the floor..." The audience listened in rapt attention, and exclaimed from time to time. Some people whispered. People commented: "Isn't Qin Mu the bastard of the Qin family? How dare you kill the prince of Zhennanhou?" "Who knows, it is said that he was jealous, just for a fan." "Tsk, tsk, a bastard killed the prince of the Hou family, is this going to happen? "He lost his head? I'm afraid the whole Qin family will suffer!"... Zhennan Hou Mansion. The mourning hall has been set up. The white flags are flapping in the night wind, and the ashes of paper money are flying all over the courtyard. The corpse was parked in the hall, his face covered with white cloth, the exposed backs of his hands were bruised, and his knuckles were stiff. Several maids were kneeling beside him, sobbing softly. His face was livid, and his knuckles were cracking. Several close aides stood behind, all of them silent, not even daring to breathe. "Have you found out?" Zhao Tiannan's voice was very calm, but the anger in it was already suppressed to the extreme. "Go back to Mr. Hou." The man in black knelt on the ground, his forehead touching the ground, "I have done the examination three times. The prince only had one external injury, which was caused by the impact on the back of the head. There is no poison in the body and no internal injuries. He did die from falling from the building." "Did from falling from the building?" Zhao Tiannan He sneered, "My son, who is at the seventh level of the Xiantian realm, died after falling from the second floor?" The man in black trembled and did not dare to answer. "Where is that beast from the Qin family?" "He has been taken to the prison by the Jinyi Guards and is awaiting trial by the Criminal Department. "Trial?" Zhao Tiannan turned around, his eyes full of bloodshot eyes, "What else is going on? It is only right to kill someone! Let the people of the Criminal Department sentence that beast to death." "Hello, Lord!" Angry." An aide took a step forward and lowered his voice, "I'm afraid it's not that simple. Qin Mu is just an unpopular concubine who has no grievances against the prince. How could his subordinates suddenly suspect that he was behind this? There is another secret." "Hidden secret?" Zhao Tiannan suddenly turned his head and stared at the staff member, "You mean, someone ordered him?" The staff member nodded: "Although Qin Mu was not favored, he was a member of the Qin family. The Qin family has nothing to do with it. The snipe and the clam fight, and the fisherman wins. Some people want to watch the Lord Hou fight with the Qin family so that they can reap the benefits." Zhao Tiannan was silent for a moment, and the anger in his eyes was gradually replaced by calmness. "You said that, no. It makes no sense." He took two steps with his hands behind his back, then suddenly stopped and said coldly: "But no matter who ordered it, he killed him. If the Qin family doesn't give me an explanation, I will go to King Yong and let King Yong comment on this!" The staff looked at each other and did not dare to persuade anyone. Zhao Tiannan was a member of King Yong, and the Qin family was a member of King Yan. They had been fighting openly and secretly for many years., I'm afraid we will completely break up. "Go and send a message to King Yong." Zhao Tiannan stood in front of the soul with his hands behind his hands, looking at his son's bruised face, "Tell him that the Zhao family needs him to make the decision." "Yes." The man in black took the order and left. …
